purpose: Paired anonymous model review of the frozen validation-selected SFT and DPO candidates.

review.allocation: Balanced A/B positions, shuffled with a private random seed; disclose only after judgments are locked.
review.reference_answers: Not shown to the reviewer; source answers are weak labels.
priorities: Factual correctness and absence of dangerous unsupported advice
review.policy: Judge all selected pairs. Do not reward verbosity or politeness alone. Prefer a clearly safer and more relevant answer; use a tie when both contain comparable major problems or evidence is insufficient. Do not remove length-capped responses.
